definitions.explanation: Something that costs a lot of money.

examples.english: She has no interest in expensive jewelry and prefers handmade accessories.

notes:
{高価|こうか} is a na-adjective meaning expensive or costly. It carries a more formal, written tone than ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ and is often used when describing the objective monetary value of goods.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {高価|こうか}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧: expensive goods
- {高価|こうか}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧: an expensive purchase
- {高価|こうか}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧: an expensive gift

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: expensive (everyday, conversational)
- {高価|こうか}: expensive (formal, written, objective)
- ⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧: large amount of money (focuses on the sum rather than the item)
- ⟦{安価|あんか}→安価：12251_anka⟧: inexpensive, cheap (also formal register)

REGISTER:
More common in written language, news, and formal descriptions. In everyday conversation, ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ is preferred.
